description: This file defines a Java interface named UserDao that specifies methods for accessing and manipulating User data, including finding, saving, and removing users.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Interface for user data access operations, including methods to find, save, and remove users.

methods.name: findUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User object corresponding to the specified userId.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Persists the given User object to the data store.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Deletes the user with the specified userId from the data store.
